chunks.title: Moong__ki_daal_ke__vade__in__South_Indian_style__#vegetarian
chunks.text: Hello guys, today we are going to make Dal Vada This is a South Indian dish starter We are making it with Moong Dal It is usually made with Chana Dal We have soaked 2 cups of Dal for 3-4 hours It is soaked now We have removed the water We have to remove 2 tbsp of water from it Now we have to grind it in a mixer We don't have to make it too fine We have made it coarse We don't have to make it too fine We have to add the Dal in it We have to add salt according to taste We have to add asafoetida Those who don't eat asafoetida should avoid it We have to add roasted coriander We have to add red chilli for Kashmiri colour We have to add chopped green chilli according to taste Those who don't eat it should avoid it We have to add 2 tbsp of chopped ginger We have to add 1 medium sized chopped onion We have to add 9-10 curry leaves We have to mix it all well We have kept oil to fry Our oil will fry well Our oil is hot now We will put the vada in it We will slow down the flame We will fry it for 2 minutes Our vada is frying We will turn it after 2 minutes We will fry it on medium flame We will keep it on medium flame We will flip it It is frying now Our fried dal vada is ready We will take it out in a plate It is fried well It has got a nice colour Our Moong Dal Vada is ready We are serving it with coconut chutney Please subscribe to our channel I know they are not doing it yet Please subscribe to our channel
